ev.q: This report describes the two incidents, which resulted in six deaths
a 51-year-old man, his 10-year-old son, a 9-year-old boy, and a 7-year-old girl were found dead
Postmortem carboxyhemoglobin (COHb) levels measured 50%, 63%, 69%, and 63%, respectively
Postmortem COHb levels in the two campers measured 68% and 76%, respectively.
two incidents among campers in Georgia illustrate the danger of CO in outdoor settings
